comment: NUK3R2 Research System — Phase 1, Narrative Intelligence Edition. The collector gathers FACTS; Claude makes the qualitative JUDGMENTS in a scorecard; score.py does the arithmetic and enforces the evidence standard. Nothing here auto-buys: the verdict is published only after the beekeeper sees the report.

liquidity_tiers.comment: Ruling R-10 bands (closes the $200K-$1M gap in the source PDF): pool Micro <$50K · Low $50K-$200K · Medium $200K-$6M · High >$6M; ±2% depth per the PDF (Low <$15K · Medium $15K-$100K · High >$100K). Tier = the LOWER of the two axes, but ONLY a measured depth counts; the collector's constant-product depth figure is an estimate, shown in the report and never used for the tier.

timing.stage_comment: Audit fix: the source PDF adds the ordinal Stage (1 Birth .. 5 Fading) straight into Timing, so a FADING story out-scored an early one. Stage is mapped to timing points instead: Early Formation 5 > Rising 4 > Birth 3 > Peak/Mature 1 > Fading 0; Revival +1 (cap 5). BEEKEEPER SETTING — change the numbers, never the direction.
